Bekham signs his name in a neat cursive font “and should I perish send my things to house dejardin... actually I suppose you should just throw it in the see no point sending back I suppose. And if that little green spider out there wants anything they’re welcome to take it before you do so”
Bekham returns “alright well since were in London I may as well head to the museum feel free to join me if that peaks your interest”

"Thank you sir, but i plan to simply wander around the streets of London. I rarely see it from the surface." Web sticks out their hand "It was lovely to meet you mons-eer Bekham. I hope to see your kind face around."

And walks off down the street toward the museam

they then head out to the streets of london, whistling a small tune

Traxim tentatively steps inside the building, looking around with a keen eye. He begins mumbling to himself with few words loud enough to be heard. After a moment, he snaps out of it and begins to look for the document he was informed he would need to sign before departure.
Vee was not a punctual person, never was. She already knows in her bones that she is late. And oh, it's back to the village and the life of waiting around if she's just missed her chance.

Eventually the sign is spotted and he walks over and fills out the form before signing it. His gaze lingers on various areas within the building before leaving, never even glancing at any of the people within.
Fettachini strides into the building and looks around for where to buy his ticket.
After reading the signs he goes over to fill out the form.

There's not a lot of people left there, which worries Vee in the moment, until she sees someone walk up to a sign, and fill in a form of some sort. She walks up to do the same, reads through the contract.

```I, Viorica Bewick of the village Bywater, promise to uphold maritime law. Should I pass untimely, present any belongings I have to my brother Aris Bewick.```

Fettachini glances at Vee's paper, not quite sure what to write...

 ```I, Fettachini -now of no family-, promise to uphold maritime law. Should I pass untimely, present any belongings I have to... the owner and proprietor of Auntie Mavis's Bed and Breakfast```
He turns in the form and hands over the ungodly sum of money to purchase the ticket
Vee pulls out the last profits of her store back in Bywater, for a ticket to what should be a new life.

Fettachini takes a spare piece of paper and scribbles a note on it, then tacks it on a bulletin board or other unofficial documents area 

```Looking for shareholders and workers for a Magical Materials market to be founded in the New World to distribute healing tonics, energizing Pastrami, and other curative and wonderous consumables ranging from strictly medicinal potions to... tonics for the more open minded.

Contact Fettachini at Auntie Mavis's Bed and Breakfast.```
Fettachini walks back outside

Navar comes in, seeming new to the area, carrying no coin purse but his pockets shake with contents seeong the sign speaking of the new world and passage he points a finger. "Who do I speak to for this?"

The luster of the previous day has gone. When not being used for official business, the Reform Club has a strict policy of silence so that well dressed old men can read their news papers, sip brandy and smoke tobacco in strict contemplative silence. Harumph.

While going through his stuff, Traxim found the form from yesterday and realized he had forgotten to turn it in and pay for the trip. He rushed back to rectify the situation by turning them both in to that butler fellow.
```
craftsman
Yes
No
Give them to someone who needs them
                                      Traxim```
Rah streaks down from the clouds and lands dramatically infront of the club, then strides straight up to the forms and begins filling one out
He cocks his feathered head at the will section and simply assigns his belongings to whoever is second-closest to him at his time of death. Chaotic. Perfect.
(Couldnt have done that for fettichini huh)

On his way out he spies an old poster on the wall and tacks a new one over it sideways. 

```Alchemist hiring in the New World. If you wish to bend the world to your will, make fortunes beyond imagination, or seek immense power: speak to Rahvioli, the white Aarakocra to apply.```
He walks out after purchasing his ticket

Gaffer wanders in and then over to the sign board. They look about for a decent spot and tac up an elaborately scribed notice. "Scrive services offered. Have your tales illuminated in grand fashion. Lasting legacies. Inquire to Gaffer Somnus Fabertell by way of Auntie Mavis' bed and breakfast or upon the Tir after departure.

Gaffer steps back to make sure it is noticeable from a bit of distance and then heads out in search of a bite to eat.
